clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Thork seeks proof that Kreenig Snarlsnout has fallen. His tusk marks the end of the Razormane leader's attacks on Horde caravans in the northern Barrens.

Horde caravans traveling west from Durotar face constant attacks in the Barrens. Those raids grew bolder under Kreenig Snarlsnout, a fierce Razormane leader. Thork, commander of the Crossroads watch, ordered Kreenig killed to disrupt the quilboars' coordination. His tusk offers proof that the leader is dead and insults the Razormane, weakening their resolve and leaving their fighters without central direction.
